decisions.reason: Adding a welcome channel and bot to the Discord server does not establish that Discord is publicly available for support or require changing the FAQ contact guidance.
The accepted Discord welcome configuration does not change any current About page content or technology description.
Discord welcome-channel and bot configuration is unrelated to ETH mint conversion, pricing, swapping, or refunds.
The Discord server change does not affect enabled payment currencies, card availability, or the payment selector.
The source decision does not alter mint tipping options, transaction flow, or buyer notices.
The Mission page uses community as general project messaging; enabling Discord welcome features does not necessarily change that content.
Discord server onboarding features do not affect NFT referral codes, ticket counters, badges, or metadata accuracy.
The source decision does not change any NFT resale or ownership-transfer semantics.
Discord welcome-channel and bot configuration does not alter the Small Block prize amount, trigger, funding, or winner rules.
The Discord community setup does not affect the Transak provider, fiat payment methods, fulfillment, or deferred lifecycle.
The accepted welcome bot and channel do not change automatic prize transfer or the payout destination.
Discord onboarding features do not change NFT badge definitions, award milestones, storage, or current effects.
